text:
The Hurricanes took the Stanley Cup champions to Finland this week, and the trip belonged to the kid from Oulu. Sebastian Aho met youth players from his hometown, scored twice against Seattle in Helsinki and was named player of the game.

The season has been just as good: 29 points in 21 games, 12 goals and 17 assists, with Carolina controlling 61.6% of the expected goals at five on five when he plays. Evolving-Hockey had him 16th among forwards in wins above replacement last season and credited him with driving play after accounting for teammates.

Some of the points will come back to earth. Carolina has scored 7.1 more goals than its chances deserve with him on the ice, and he is shooting 20.7% against a usual range nearer 14.5%. Our projection still lands between 81 and 108 points, 94 in the middle.

What to watch: in Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking, he ranked in the 93rd percentile of forwards for primary shot assists. The next shot after he touches the puck is often a teammate's.
